conventions.affiliations: Direct-kind sources follow the citations31 direct10 convention: an affiliation object is added only for an explicit, unambiguous attachment in the citation ("... of INSTITUTION" shared by the connected list, or a parenthetical after one name). creator426-kind sources follow their reviewed cohort notes, which add no affiliation objects; institutions stay in the preserved citation.
conventions.honorific_rank_role: Honorifics (Dr., Mr.), military ranks (CWO3) and stated roles (editor) are not name parts. They are left out of the name fields and preserved verbatim in the preservation paragraph, as the citations31 policy did for FGDC-2597 ("Dr. Hatakeyama, former Director-General ..." -> Hatakeyama).
conventions.particle: A nobility particle stays where the source's own inverted form puts it ("Boguslawski, G. Von" -> family_name "Boguslawski", given_name "G. Von").
conventions.suffix: Generational suffixes (Jr., III) stay with the given names in the inverted citation form the sources themselves use ("Farley, E.V., Jr."): family_name "Farley", given_name "Edward V., Jr.". The provider displays family_name, given_name, so the record reads "Farley, Edward V., Jr." and the DataCite familyName stays the family name. This is a representation convention for the independent reviewer to confirm, not a claim that the suffix is a given name; InvenioRDM has no suffix field.
